Z7 WHAT THIS CANNOT SHOW
The per-unit costs for QM/MM, FEP and MD are ASSUMED at literature scale and not
measured here. Z2 swept them over four orders of magnitude and the class ordering
did not move, which is the only claim this loop makes about them.
Better methods exist and will keep arriving. Nothing here says the barrier problem
is permanently unsolvable -- only that no route THIS PROJECT MEASURED reaches a
usable accuracy on a rate.
Z4's chain model assumes multiplicative log-normal errors. A constrained system can
do much better: loop 156 measured growth-rate sensitivity to median kcat at 0.0034
against 0.9966 for elongation rate, and loop 101 got a doubling time of 13.3 h
against a measured 24 h with NO kcat at all. Conservation laws do not propagate
error the way rate chains do, and that is the loophole this whole costing leaves
open.
